Prioritize real canine anatomy and believable landing/contact over literal exact sketch joint coordinates. Photo only, no guides/lines/jointmarkers/text/watermark/grid/montage/collar/harness/hands. The frame must contain FOUR total legs and FOUR total paw ends: two white grounded front paws, two white airborne rear paws.
